verdict.rationale: Salv documents an in-product AI-Powered Insights feature that adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning. That is a direct form of AI-generated insight, but it is confined to a single use case and is informational only, so it does not show broad insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. Missing for 10: AI insights beyond sanctions name-match adjudication (e.g., transaction monitoring, cases, risk), AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, in-depth documentation of how the feature works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning, but it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.
